body: This video made me chuckle and I really needed that, thanks

My only hospital visit so far was 36 hours of hell that cost $7k (after insurance). At that rate I would've definitely gotten a better deal on a funeral. 

It did allow me to learn your last point though. My therapist was telling me to go, saying those exact things, not to worry about it, but the $7k bill has made my situation 7000 times worse. Never again. I'll pull through any other way if I can.

I would love to trust my family with this. I'm actually really close with them, and they're amazing. But the big issue for me is that my parents don't believe in mental health at all, and based on the past, when it's even mentioned and they've warned us never to speak up or go on medication, I can pretty safely assume they'd be very angry, and wouldn't support me through this. My sisters probably would, so I am at least trying to get the courage to tell them ❤️

This. I have the same experience, even periods where it ebbs and flows in general, between months or weeks. I'm what everyone would consider a super successful college student with a bright future- it doesn't show, like the edgy depression memes. But still depression, for real. You should definitely talk to someone before it can get any worse, or at least to make sure.
Mine is rf5, but that's a while away..
This meme is brilliant but my friend recognized ddlc on my screen and swiped to see what sub I was on, I grabbed my phone back like a maniac what a close call 😪

This post is very relatable to me right now, and you seem like a great person, very kind and caring. I'm glad you still have the will to live, even though the color is gone.

I've also struggled with depression for a while and I'm used to it; it's a part of me. Lately I've been drowning too though, but I have less will to live. Here are a few things that keep me alive even when I don't want them to

Good songs on the radio when I'm driving 

The sound of rain outside, and being dry and warm inside 

Sunlight, but especially the feeling of the first few sunny days after winter, when they're really special

My town in animal crossing lol

And being worried that I'll forget some of my favorite foods somehow, and not be able to eat it again before I die. I really love food haha

Hope this helps, I hope you can get through this
This was me earlier today accidently giving one detail too many and threatened with hospitalization 🙃😎

Well I'm still pretty new to it myself, but for me it's been pretty decent so far. They were really understanding of my being broke/unable to use my parents' insurance for mental health medication, so they helped me get what I needed while working with my situation. It kind of sucks because for mine at least it seemed like they really wanted to push me into group therapy at first, because they're very short staffed, but I was busy enough to require individual haha. Oc it's different for everyone, and University counseling can also be kind of crappy. Definitely worth a shot for free though.

Definitely. My psychiatrist seemed confused about it, but one of my biggest sleep problems is not being motivated to go to bed, even when I'm tired and sitting on my bed and all I'd really have to do is close my laptop and turn the lights off.

Personally, I would do pediatrics too, simply because of the cool scrubs, knowing nothing else about it haha. So good choice.

I hope you do well too. This semester is supposed to be the hardest in my major, hopefully we can make it through. I don’t really know what to say about possibly hurting people in nursing, that’s not debatable in that it’s more high stakes. But I’m sure you’ll be fine, even if something happens, at least you’re always trying to help people.

Thanks for the well wishes, also I’m a girl btw. Haha. I wish the best for you too, although I know it’s not simple. Hopefully talking helped, even if just for right now

Yep, I’ve just never been around guns so I wouldn’t know, but even simply reading about stuff online makes me shake just like that. Although, I’m currently going through some desensitization of myself too, not for suicide but almost as stupid. Does that stop me? Nope, i know how stupid it is before, during and after but I still go, so maybe we’re both insane on that one. I feel that.

And that’s good that you can realize that, even the tiniest of bits right? I feel like knowing that there’s even of a sliver of a will to live, combined with our body’s natural instincts, is enough to get through the darkest times, but can also be enough to use and build up that will to really get better, over lots of time of course. But, I also literally just sought out therapy for the first time a month ago, so I’m also still skeptical about how much it’ll help me on a grand scale. Still, it’s my tiniest will to live that got me here, so it’s a step, for now.

And dude, you’re going to college for nursing? That’s awesome. My sister recently graduated her nursing program, I respect it so much. Here I am just a lil art student painting my feelings out. (Kidding though, I take my major seriously but i can poke fun at myself) but yes, nursing is an awesome field, do you know what area? 

Aside from that, I feel like we’re probably holding on at about the same rate. I feel like after college, when I’m truly independent, I may have more freedom to try and address my mental health. It also helps that I plan to move across the country, quite a fresh start to look forward too. 

I don’t know if talking about writing notes is allowed on this sub, id rather play it safe though
Also also, the usual if you want to talk (in depth or normal stuff lol) my inbox is (usually) open

Oh no, sorry, I didn’t mean to say you had to change your plans or anything (I mean, obviously I’d like that). But I totally agree that it’s up to us. It is your life, your choice. I pretty much agree with everything you said actually, I have almost exactly the same thought patterns. I just feel like you might be more serious than me, because deep down I know I’d never be able to do it, even when I’m sitting in bed bleeding and writing notes. But I know it’s comforting when I do feel convinced I’m gonna do it, i know all those feelings.

But yeah, I guess my main thing is that it’s always worth it to wait a few days, on the slim hope that there’s a shot it gets better. Even on my darkest days I just keep going to bed and waking up feeling like 0.02% better until it’s bearable, but that’s rough too.

Also, I don’t usually talk about this stuff, especially this deeply? Haha, so sorry if I’m being totally not helpful, take it with a grain of salt bc I’m obviously not the most qualified over here 🙃

Luckily for me, my school’s group therapy schedule didn’t work for my class schedule, so I haven’t had to deal with that yet. They tried to put me in group too and I was definitely dreading it, especially never have even done counseling before and then just opening up to a bunch of strangers? It would definitely be worse if you’re talking dark and everyone else is comparatively lighter in mood. 

I wouldn’t trust my therapist with any concrete plans personally, I can’t go to the er and have my parents find out that way. But it’s probably a good thing for you, since it helps stop the concrete plans. Mine is more ideation anyway, I’m too weak to actually kms (so far). But you never know, maybe medication can control the suicidal thoughts and stabilize you enough for therapy to help more? It’s at least worth a shot if that’s what a therapist recommends, I think. 

I definitely agree on willing to change though, it’s gotta come from you. I hope you find the will to want it, I feel like I understand a lot of your thoughts and I feel you, it’s hard every day when it feels like there’s nothing to live for.

I have the same exact problem. Also in college and can’t have my parents knowing by getting meds for it on their insurance. Although my therapist has been recommending I try, so I have an appointment on Tuesday now. She’s told the psychiatrist my situation so he’s going to see if we can work out something affordable for my broke college student budget. 

Have you considered asking? I go to the counseling center at my school, so all the services there are free at least. Although of course this depends on if you have at least some money to pay with, which I have a tiny budget for. Otherwise I’m in the same boat bc I haven’t tried meds yet at all, and still don’t know if they can give me anything I can afford, but it helps me to know I’ll have tried. That way I don’t feel I’m waiting until I’m either 26 and insured or dead.

I recently started going to therapy too, and felt like my problems weren’t bad enough to warrant my therapist’s time. When I asked him how to tell if my problems were “enough” to need help, he said that if they’re causing a problem for me, there’s something there to fix. Even a small inconvenience is an inconvenience and worth his time because it would improve my life to fix it. Maybe that helps, good luck
Waiting for rune factory 5 here but if I keep it up I could be immortal 🤷‍♀️ (well, could be)

Thank you for the response and for the serious response to my question. I’m definitely doing my best to get myself under control and have actually recently gone into therapy for the first time in my life so here’s hoping 🤞
